_comment: Reference locale. Keys are grouped by screen area. {placeholders} are substituted at runtime and must be preserved in every translation.
lang.label: Language
gate.login.subtitle: Protected access
gate.setup.title: Welcome
gate.setup.subtitle: Choose a password to protect this device.
gate.setup.warning: Until a password is set, anyone on your network can configure this streamer. Set one now.
player.volume_locked_title: Volume locked — set the level on your amplifier
player.volume_locked_hint: Volume locked: the DAC sits at full output and never attenuates. Set the level on your amplifier.
audio.title: Audio output
audio.volume_mode_hint: “Locked” holds the DAC at full output and leaves the volume to your amplifier — the classic fixed line output. Otherwise the slider above drives the DAC's own attenuator, which keeps the stream bit-perfect.
audio.gapless_hint: Plays tracks back to back with no silence — worthwhile on a live album or a continuous mix. Known drawback: prefetching can swallow a track change requested from the Qobuz app, which then keeps playing the previous track.
qobuz.title: Qobuz account
qobuz.url_hint: Open this link in your browser to authorise the device:
qconnect.title: Qobuz Connect
qconnect.name_label: Name shown in the Qobuz app
system.title: System status
wifi.title: Wi-Fi network
wifi.warning_body: You are viewing this page over Wi-Fi. If the change fails, the device automatically returns to the previous network. But if it succeeds and you moved to a different network, the Pi will disappear from this one — you will have to join the new network to reach it again.
wifi.psk_placeholder: Leave empty for an open network
wifi.confirm:
Join “{ssid}”?

If the connection fails, the device will return to the current network automatically.
If it succeeds and this is a different network, this page will stop responding: you will need to join “{ssid}” to reach the streamer again.
wifi.no_response: No response ({error}). If the network changed, join it and reload this page.
security.title: Security
banner.power_body: The Pi reports {flags} right now. Use a 5.1 V / 2.5 A supply — this is the leading cause of dropouts.
banner.nopw_body: Anyone on your network can change these settings.
banner.thermal_body: The Pi is reducing its speed to cool down. Check ventilation around the case.
player.volume_hardware_hint: Hardware volume, applied inside the DAC ({control}) — the stream stays bit-perfect.
player.volume_unavailable_title: This DAC exposes no volume control
player.volume_unavailable_hint: Volume is unavailable: this converter exposes no hardware volume control, and software attenuation is disabled in bit-perfect mode. Use your amplifier.
banner.stream_error_note: kept until the daemon restarts, so it may already be resolved.
